title: Driver Standards Bulletin: Agreement Standing and Temporary For-Hire Permit Acceptance
content:
**Driver Services Agreements and Account Standing.** The standing of a Wayfare driver agreement on the day a temporary for-hire permit is uploaded bears on the temporary permit acceptance days, the calendar days from the upload day for which the temporary permit is accepted as the for-hire permit on file.

**Standard.** On an agreement deactivated with its deactivation date on or before the upload day, the temporary permit acceptance days change by -10 days (10 days fewer); on an agreement on hold with its hold start date on or before the upload day, they change by -5 days (5 days fewer); on an agreement in any other standing, they do not change.

| Standing on the upload day | Date read | Change |
|---|---|---|
| deactivated | deactivation date on or before the upload day | -10 |
| on hold | hold start date on or before the upload day | -5 |
| any other (for example active) | none | 0 |

**Readings (hypothetical, upload day 2026-09-05).**
- On hold with a hold start date of 2026-09-05: on or before the upload day, change -5.
- Deactivated on 2026-08-01: change -10.
- Active: no change.
